questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设有一半径为 R，中心角为 } \varphi \text{ 的均匀圆弧形细棒(线密度为 } \rho \text{)，在圆心处有一质量为 m }\text{ 的质点 M，试求这细棒对质点 M 的引力.} \end{aligned}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{array}{l} { r } { F _ { x } = \frac { k m \rho } { 2 R } \sin \frac { \varphi } { 2 } , F _ { y } = 0 \, . } \end{array}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}F_x = \frac{km\rho}{R} \sin \frac{\varphi}{2}, F_y = 0\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}F_x = \frac{3km\rho}{R} \sin \frac{\varphi}{2}, F_y = 0\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}F_{x} = \frac{2km\rho}{R} \sin \frac{\varphi}{2}, F_{y} = 0\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答：} \ F_{x} = k \int_{-\frac{\varphi}{2}}^{\frac{\varphi}{2}} \frac{m \rho}{R} \cos \theta d\theta = \frac{2 k m \rho}{R} \sin \frac{\varphi}{2}, F_{y} = 0

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设星形线}x=a\cos^{3}t,y=a\sin^{3}t \text {上每一点处的线密度的大小等于该点到原点距离的立方.} \\ \text {在原点}O \text {处有一单位质点，求星形线在第一象限的弧段对这质点的引力.} \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}F_x = F_y = \frac{3}{5} ka^2\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}F_x = \frac{3}{5} ka^2 \,, F_y = 0 \, .\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \boldsymbol { F } _ { x } = \boldsymbol { F } _ { y } = a ^ { 2 }

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}F_x = F_y = \frac{3}{4} ka^2\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答：} \ F_{x} = k \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} a \cos^{3} t \sqrt{[3 a \cos^{2} t (-\sin t)]^{2} + [3 a \sin^{2} t \cos t]^{2}} \, dt = \frac{3}{5} k a^{2} \, , \ F_{y} = F_{x}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {自地面垂直向上发射火箭(如图)，问火箭应达到什么速度} \\ \text {才可在无动力的情况下飞离地球?} \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: \upsilon = \sqrt { 2 g R }

options.label: B
options.html: \upsilon = \sqrt { 3 g R }

options.label: C
options.html: \ v = \sqrt { g R }

options.label: D
options.html: \nu = \sqrt { g R / 2 }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：由万有引力定律，在距地心}x(x\geq R)\text{处火箭所受的引力为}F=\frac{mgR^{2}}{x^{2}}\text{（}m\text{为火箭质量）.火箭上升到}r\text{处引力所做的功为}W=\int_{R}\frac{mgR^{2}}{x^{2}}dx=mgR^{2}\left(\frac{1}{R}-\frac{1}{r}\right).\text{由能量守恒定律，火箭要无限远离地球，必须使其初速满足}\frac{1}{2}mv^{2}=\lim_{r\rightarrow\infty}W=mgR\Rightarrow v=\sqrt{2gR}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设有一无限长的，线密度为} \mu \text{的均匀细直棒，在起中垂线上距} a \text{单位处有一质量为} m \text{的质点} M, \text{计算该棒对质点的引力.}

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{2km\mu}{a}

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{3km\mu}{a}

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{4km\mu}{a}

options.label: D
options.html: \frac { k m \mu } { 2 a }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：建立坐标系如图细棒上小段}[x,x+dx]\text{对质点的引力大小为}dF&=k\frac{m\mu dx}{a^2+x^2}\\ dF_y&=-dFcod\alpha\\ \text{故垂直分力元素为}&=-k\frac{m\mu dx}{a^2+x^2}\cdot\frac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+x^2}}=-km\mu a\frac{dx}{\left(a^2+x^2\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\\ \text{棒对质点的引力垂直分力为}\\ F_y&=-2km\mu a\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{dx}{\left(a^2+x^2\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\\ &=-km\mu a\left[\frac{x}{a^2\sqrt{a^2+x^2}}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\\ &=-\frac{2km\mu l}{a}\frac{1}{\sqrt{4a^2+l^2}}\\ \text{棒对质点引力的水平分力为}F_x&=0.\\ \text{故棒对质点的引力大小为}F&=\frac{2km\mu l}{a}\frac{1}{\sqrt{4a^2+l^2}}\\ \text{棒对质点的引力大小为}F&=\frac{2km\mu l}{a}\frac{1}{\sqrt{4a^2+l^2}}\\ \text{细棒很长时，可视}l\text{为无穷大，此时引力大小为}\frac{2km\mu}{a}\text{，方向与细棒垂直且指向细棒。}\end{aligned}
